summary: Iteration 3 (jurisdictions + Decipher→Anchor context wiring) verified end-to-end. 12/12 new backend pytest tests pass: GET /api/jurisdictions returns 11 codes, /api/orders/analyze accepts jurisdiction form field (TX → Texas) and works without it, /api/chat with order_id+jurisdiction returns reply citing doc deadlines + context_label 'Temporary Orders · <filename>', bogus order_id returns 200 with null context_label, jurisdiction-only chat works, all prior endpoints regress green. Frontend Playwright walk passed every gate: Decipher jurisdiction Select (Texas) submitted, decipher-result-jurisdiction badge rendered 'Texas', Anchor CTA href=/chat?order=...&jurisdiction=TX, Chat banner+filename rendered, header subtitle ended in '· TX', jurisdiction trigger preset to Texas, greeting referenced the doc, order-specific starters shown, sent message returned a reply citing the 14-day co-parenting class deadline, chat-clear-order removed the banner and restored the generic greeting, chat-decipher-link visible when no order.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: chat() reads order_analyses by id and rebuilds system_message per call — correct (no leaked state). Bogus order_id silently falls through (no 404) which matches stated requirement.
server.py: _jurisdiction_addendum gracefully handles unknown codes; uppercases input. Good.
server.py: analyze_order stores 'jurisdiction' uppercased (analyzed_order['jurisdiction']=='TX') — frontend deep-link uses that, consistent.
Chat.jsx: greeting effect resets sessionId on order/orderId change — prevents context bleed across sessions; nice.
Decipher.jsx: anchor CTA encodes order id (encodeURIComponent) and conditionally appends jurisdiction — correct.
server.py is now ~800 lines. Consider splitting routes/seed/llm into modules in a follow-up — not blocking.
Minor: After 'clear-order', jurisdiction stays selected (Texas) — defensible UX (user picked it explicitly), but worth confirming with design intent.
test_credentials: None required. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY powers both Anthropic (chat) + Gemini (decipher).
seed_data_creation: Test run created ~2 order_analyses docs (1 TX, 1 no-jurisdiction) + 1 chat_messages thread + TEST_ contact/booking. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full iteration 3 surface area covered. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/{test_unbound_api.py,test_decipher.py,test_iteration3.py}. New testids in scope: decipher-jurisdiction-trigger, decipher-jurisdiction-<CODE>, decipher-result-jurisdiction, decipher-cta-anchor (Link with /chat?order=&jurisdiction=), chat-order-context-banner, chat-order-filename, chat-clear-order, chat-jurisdiction-trigger, chat-jurisdiction-<CODE>, chat-decipher-link, chat-msg-assistant-N, chat-starters. Anchor reliably cites doc-specific deadlines when order_id resolves — assertion strategy is to lowercase the reply and look for any of: ['14','co-parenting','class','deadline','child support','march'].
